description: Work interest areas from the ACT World of Work Map (used as-is, not invented; see https://davetgc.com/Worldwork.htm — Ahmad's input #2). The map organizes work by four primary interests: working with Ideas, People, Data, or Things. 'tag_areas' maps our programme tags onto those areas so every programme resolves to at least one interest area.

areas.name: Ideas
areas.description: Abstract work: words, equations, art, music, theories, design.

areas.name: People
areas.description: Helping, serving, teaching, caring, persuading, leading.

areas.name: Data
areas.description: Facts, numbers, files, accounts, business procedures.

areas.name: Things
areas.description: Machines, tools, materials, structures, plants and animals.
